text:
Alex S.: QuasarHealth opened a ticket — they saw a surge of 504s during an ingress traffic spike in us-west. Edge logs show a lot of upstream half-closed / keepalive resets. Customer reports SDK retry loops and duplicate billing.
Priya R.: Oncall here, thanks for the ping. Any request ids or sample logs?
Alex S.: Pasting a short snippet from the edge (sanitized):
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -d '{"prompt":"<1MB prompt>"}'
* Connected to edge-xyz (10.0.0.1) port 443 (#0)
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
< x-edge-error: upstream half-closed
```
Priya R.: Got it. Mateo, can ingress side confirm connection counts / TIME_WAIT storm?
Mateo G.: Seeing a large spike in simultaneous connections from Quasar's IP block around 08:12 UTC. Many connections go into CLOSE_WAIT / TIME_WAIT and the edge shows upstreams half-closing when backend pools are saturated. Looks like keepalive reuse mismatch between client and upstream.
Jordan L.: Runtime note: KV cache lock contention would manifest differently, but these 504s look like the edge proxy is closing while runtime still processing. If the SDK aggressively reuses connections after a half-close, we get retried requests piling up and the edge runs out of multiplex slots.
Claire M.: Support update: asked Quasar to throttle client concurrency and flip SDK to exponential backoff for now. They've asked for a billing hold while we investigate duplicate billing from retries.
Alex S.: Quasar provided repro steps:
1) spawn 40-60 concurrent keepalive connections
2) POST ~1MB prompt repeatedly (they use batching client-side)
3) enable default SDK retries (fast)
They attached a curl stress command that reproduces ~10% 504s locally.
```
for i in {1..50}; do \
  curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @large_prompt.json https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate &\
 done; wait
```
Mateo G.: Temporary mitigation applied on us-west edge pool: bumped keepalive_timeout -> 70s and reduced max_keepalive_requests to avoid pooled half-closed reuse. Also increased accept queue depth on the proxy. Rolling monitoring now.
Jordan L.: Deployed a runtime temporary fallback for that tenant: smaller batch sizes and a faster kv-cache backoff to reduce in-flight work. Will revert when stable.
Priya R.: Early metrics: 504 rate for affected tenant dropped from ~18% -> ~2% after edge change and customer throttling. Still seeing scattered half-close resets but far fewer user-visible errors.
Claire M.: Customer confirmed: after pausing aggressive retries they see significantly fewer errors. Billing hold requested — approving provisional hold pending postmortem.
Alex S.: Filing an internal P0 to SRE + runtime, attaching pcap and aggregated logs. Please triage followups and RCA.
incident-bot: Incident created: #INC-2024-8451, assigned to eng-sre, priority P1.
Priya R.: Next steps: 1) full postmortem, 2) add SDK guidance (avoid heavy concurrent keepalive reuse and recommend jittered backoff), 3) add an edge knob to detect halfclose storms and proactively drain or shadow requests.
Jordan L.: I'll open a PR to add a runtime detector that gracefully rejects requests when upstream half-close patterns spike and add telemetery for half-closed counts. Target: PR by EOD.
Alex S.: Thanks everyone. Leaving thread open until the postmortem is published and billing hold is finalized.
